  • AI agents
    67%
    Tier-1 deflection

    Customer-support agent that resolves 67% of tickets

    A Claude-powered support agent grounded in the help centre and policy docs, with hard escalation rules around money movement. Two months in: 67% deflection at 4.6 out of 5 satisfaction. Sample case study, full reference engagement available on request.

  • Process automation
    3d to same-day
    Onboarding time

    Onboarding cycle time: 3 days to same day

    A single intake form in HubSpot now triggers a Zapier sequence that fires the contract, provisions Slack, creates the Drive folder, schedules the kickoff, and posts the welcome message. All before the new client refreshes their email.

    US marketing agency · 40 employees
  • Data pipelines
    5,200
    SKUs tracked daily

    Daily price monitoring across 5,200 SKUs

    A Playwright pipeline scrapes 12 competitor sites at off-peak hours and surfaces a Looker dashboard of price gaps, undercutting alerts, and stock-out opportunities. The pricing analyst now spends 30 minutes a day acting on the data.

    UK ecommerce · homewares
